slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

systems.platform: OpenEMIS (the row cites an OpenEMIS Libya portal)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: launched July 2024; piloted in 205 institutions nationwide, using online surveys for data on students and staff

note: The Libya school row describes the EMIS as aggregate collection by online survey, a census, so no fact; its remarks on paper records at rural primary schools are worded as likely and as no evidence found, not as a statement that records are on paper.
